d_and_a.source: deskstack: us-gaap:Depreciation + AmortizationOfIntangibleAssets (FY24 15,200+4,800; FY25 22,000+6,000; FY26 34,300+4,700), acc. 0001193125-26-323660

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2026 growth was 17.8% (331,839 vs 281,724); fade as AI/cloud base grows and law of large numbers applies.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2026 margin 46.8% (155,237/331,839), FY2025 45.6%; held slightly below FY26 given rising depreciation from heavy capex.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. FY2026 effective rate implied by pretax 165,934 and net income 133,749 (19.4%), slightly lower for forecast; reviewer to confirm.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: D&A was 11.8% of revenue in FY2026 (39,000/331,839), rising as capex build-out depreciates.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2026 capex 34.9% of revenue (115,948), FY2025 22.9%; average ~25% over forecast as investment intensity normalizes. Aggressive uncertainty; reviewer to check.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + assumed beta 1.05 x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = 9.5% cost of equity; debt ~5% of capital (debt 40,294) so WACC approx equal to cost of equity. Beta is an assumption, not looked up.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate and near long-run nominal US GDP growth.

net_debt.source: deskstack derived net_debt = total debt 40,294 - cash 20,935 - short-term investments 55,908, acc. 0001193125-26-323660

diluted_shares.source: Weighted average diluted shares 7,453 million, acc. 0001193125-26-323660
